name: nlmixr2llm
description: Task-oriented skills and an orchestrating agent for the nlmixr2 pharmacometric ecosystem in R: simulation (rxode2), estimation (nlmixr2), reporting (GOF, VPC, tables, Word/PowerPoint via nlmixr2rpt, xpose, ggPMX), interop with NONMEM/Monolix/PKNCA (babelmixr2, nonmem2rx, monolix2rx), and optimal design (PopED via babelmixr2).
